subject: Banking
title: Credit Cards Decoded
description: A fast breakdown of Credit Cards Decoded for builders.

hook.text: Credit cards charge an average APR of 24%. If you carry a balance.

buildup.text: Cards offer a grace period of 21-25 days. Pay the full balance and interest is zero.

discovery.text: Minimum payments are designed to maximize interest. Paying only the minimum on $5,000 takes 22 years and costs $7,000.

twist.text: The rewards system is funded by interchange fees charged to merchants, which raise prices for everyone.

climax.text: Credit cards reward discipline and punish debt. The same product is free for some and devastating for others.

punchline.text: Pay in full: free money. Carry a balance: 24% annual cost.

quiz.question: How long does it take to repay $5,000 at minimum payments?
